name: tool-till-tees
title: Utilities API
description: Contact form endpoint, multi-tenant form builder, and agreement management backend. All backed by Supabase.
audience: Internal infrastructure — provides backend services consumed by see-veo (contact form) and other frontends (form builder, Sancio agreement management).
useCases: Receive and deliver contact form submissions via SMTP
Build and publish custom forms with conditional fields and validation
Collect and manage form submissions with status tracking
Manage two-party agreements with proposals, signatures, and notifications (Sancio)
Generate PDF verifications for signed agreements

dataPrivacy.storage: All data stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL) with row-level security.
dataPrivacy.authentication: JWT-based anonymous auth. Users can only access their own data.
dataPrivacy.security: CORS allowlist, input validation, HTML escaping, honeypot fields, security headers.
